stories.title: AI could upend food delivery
stories.simple_summary: A small AI startup called Bites is trying to use artificial intelligence to change how food delivery works, competing with much larger companies like DoorDash.
stories.why_it_matters: If this works well, it might change how you order food delivered — but right now it's just starting out in one area, so it's too early to know if it will actually catch on.

stories.title: ChatGPT for Teens is an ‘unacceptable risk,’ says Common Sense Media
stories.simple_summary: A child safety organization says OpenAI's new ChatGPT version made for teenagers has serious safety problems and shouldn't be used by that age group.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have teenagers, this suggests being cautious about letting them use this particular tool without adult supervision.

stories.title: Opinion | US risks ceding AI governance leadership to China and the EU
stories.simple_summary: This headline is too vague to explain properly based on what's provided.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government officials and large tech companies — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: AI Agents Turn Permission Into Payments’ New Control Point
stories.simple_summary: AI programs are starting to handle payment permissions in new ways, giving companies different ways to control how money moves.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to payment processing companies and tech engineers — nothing most small business owners need to worry about today.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google stop short of AI safety guarantee
stories.simple_summary: Major AI companies like OpenAI, Google, and Meta have not committed to guarantees about making their AI systems completely safe.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly relevant to investors and people concerned with regulation — it doesn't directly affect how you use AI in daily life.

stories.title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
stories.simple_summary: An investor is saying that companies are spending huge amounts of money on AI that isn't producing real value yet, and he thinks different technology will be better.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an investor's opinion about future trends — nothing you need to act on, though it shows AI is still unpredictable.

stories.title: OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's AI system has solved hundreds of difficult math problems that mathematicians have been trying to solve for years.
stories.why_it_matters: This is impressive for math researchers and computer scientists, but it doesn't affect your daily life or small business operations.

stories.title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
stories.simple_summary: A group of engineers left a company called Ramp and started a new AI company called Melius that makes advertising materials and campaigns automatically.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business and create ads, AI tools that design ads for you might eventually become useful — but this company is still very new.

stories.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is sharing information about how their AI solved mathematical problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly of interest to math researchers and engineers — nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Read the charter for the White House’s ‘Super Intelligence Force’
stories.simple_summary: The White House has created a group called the 'Super Intelligence Force' to help lead policy decisions about powerful AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people following government policy — it doesn't directly change how you use AI today, but it may affect AI rules in the future.

stories.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
stories.simple_summary: A company called Musubi made an AI tool designed to help websites decide which user comments or posts to remove or keep (content moderation).
stories.why_it_matters: This is useful for large websites and social media companies, but doesn't directly affect ordinary people or small business owners.

stories.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
stories.simple_summary: A company called Lambda that builds specialized computers for AI is raising billions of dollars and plans to sell stock to the public in 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on, though it shows people are betting a lot of money on AI hardware.
